errors.evidence: The description incorrectly assigns 'Other Services' to dark blue and 61% (19.0 million) in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart. The correct sector is 'Industry' (gold/yellow) with 61% (19.0 million).
The description incorrectly assigns 'Construction' to 19% (5.9 million) in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart. The correct sector is 'Trade' (red) with 19% (5.9 million).
The description incorrectly assigns 'Trade' to 12% (3.7 million) in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart. The correct sector is 'Other Services' (brown) with 12% (3.7 million).
The description incorrectly assigns 'Industry' to 8% (2.4 million) in the 'Number of Enterprises' chart. The correct sector is 'Construction' (blue) with 8% (2.4 million).

The description incorrectly assigns 'Other Services' to dark blue and 51% (80.2 million) in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart. The correct sector is 'Industry' (gold/yellow) with 51% (80.2 million).
The description incorrectly assigns 'Industry' to 21% (33.0 million) in the 'Number of Persons Employed' chart. The correct sector is 'Other Services' (brown) with 21% (33.0 million).
The description incorrectly assigns 'Other Services' to dark blue and 31% (9.9 trillion) in the 'Turnover' chart. The correct sector is 'Trade' (red) with 31% (9.9 trillion).
The description incorrectly assigns 'Industry' to 33% (10.6 trillion) in the 'Turnover' chart. The correct sector is 'Other Services' (brown) with 33% (10.6 trillion).
The description incorrectly refers to the charts as 'donut charts'. The figure shows pie charts, not donut charts.
The description incorrectly uses 'dark blue' for 'Other Services'. The correct color is brown.
The description incorrectly uses 'gold' for 'Industry'. The correct color is yellow.
The description does not explicitly state the chart's purpose as representing the distribution of enterprises, employment, and net turnover by sector in 2021 as a percentage of the total economy.
